title: ITV / Connected network motion reel

location.extent: Whole original clip; PNG is one representative frame

slide_intent: Use a moving sequence to test continuity between streaming navigation, programme promotion and channel identity, because change over time can orient attention and distinguish channels.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen recognition and navigation across the network.
demonstration: The reel moves from an X mark and a television streaming interface through programme footage, scheduling typography and pink ITV2 identity animations, ending with ITVX.
practical_value: Use a moving sequence to test continuity between streaming navigation, programme promotion and channel identity.

content_islands.spec: X and a television interface identify the streaming context.

content_islands.name: Programmes
content_islands.spec: Footage and scheduling copy carry content.

content_islands.name: Channel identity
content_islands.spec: ITV2 numerals and stacked Back Soon type introduce a distinct motion personality.

content_islands.name: Close
content_islands.spec: The ITVX logo returns on dark ground.
